        local BillboardGui = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
        BillboardGui.Name = "ESPDistanceTag"
        BillboardGui.Adornee = Head
        BillboardGui.Size = UDim2.new(0, 200, 0, 50)
        BillboardGui.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 0.5, 0)
        BillboardGui.AlwaysOnTop = true
        BillboardGui.Parent = p21
        local TextLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        TextLabel.Name = "DistanceLabel"
        TextLabel.Parent = BillboardGui
        TextLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
        TextLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        TextLabel.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
        TextLabel.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
        TextLabel.TextSize = 12
        TextLabel.FontFace = Font.fromEnum(Enum.Font.GothamBold)
        TextLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        TextLabel.Text = "..."
        local connection
        connection = t2.value24.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
            local v719 = not p21

            if not v719 then
                v719 = not p21.Parent

                if not v719 then
                    v719 = not HumanoidRootPart

                    if not v719 then
                        v719 = not HumanoidRootPart.Parent
                    end
                end
            end

            if v719 then
                if connection then
                    connection:Disconnect()
                end

                if BillboardGui then
                    BillboardGui:Destroy()
                end

                return
            end

            if os.clock() - 0 < 0.1 then
                return
            end

            local CurrentCamera = workspace.CurrentCamera

            if CurrentCamera then
                TextLabel.Text = math.floor((CurrentCamera.CFrame.Position - HumanoidRootPart.Position).Magnitude) .. "m"
            end
        end)
        t2.value19[p21] = connection
    end)
end

    local function v266(p46)
        if not p46 or p46.Locked then
            return nil
        end

        local Model = p46:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")

        if Model then
            local player = t8.value2:GetPlayerFromCharacter(Model)

            if player and player ~= t8.value8 then
                local HumanoidRootPart = Model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

                if HumanoidRootPart then
                    return HumanoidRootPart
                end
            end

            if Model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") and not t8.value2:GetPlayerFromCharacter(Model) then
                local HumanoidRootPart = Model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

                if HumanoidRootPart then
                    return HumanoidRootPart
                end
            end

            if Model:FindFirstAncestor(t8.value8.Name) == t8.value9 then
                return nil
            end

            local PrimaryPart = Model.PrimaryPart

            if PrimaryPart then
                PrimaryPart = Model.PrimaryPart:IsA("BasePart")
            end

            if PrimaryPart then
                p46 = Model.PrimaryPart
            end
        end

        if p46.AssemblyRootPart then
            p46 = p46.AssemblyRootPart
        end

        if p46:IsA("BasePart") and p46.Parent then
            if p46:FindFirstAncestor(t8.value8.Name) == t8.value9 then
                return nil
            end

            return p46
        end

        return nil
    end

    end
    local function v268()

                    v411.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)

            end
        end

        t8.value33 = {}
    end

    function t8.value1.throwPartGrab(p48)
        if not p48 or not p48.part then
            return
        end

        local part = p48.part
        local v419 = p48.root or (part.AssemblyRootPart or part)
        local LookVector = t8.value13.CFrame.LookVector

    local function v271(p60)
        if not p60 then
            return false
        end

        if t8.value91[p60] ~= nil then
            return t8.value91[p60]
        end

        local v541 = p60.Name:lower()
        local v542, v543, v544 = ipairs({
			"wall",
			"floor",
			"ceiling",
			"roof",
			"ground",
			"platform",
			"block",
			"brick",
			"stone",
			"concrete",
			"metal",
			"wood",
			"glass",
			"barrier",
			"fence",
			"gate",
			"door",
			"window",
			"pillar",
			"column",
			"beam"
		})

        repeat
            local v545

            v544, v545 = v542(v543, v544)

            if not v544 then
                if p60.Transparency > 0.3 then
                    t8.value91[p60] = false

                    return false
                end

                if p60:IsA("Part") and p60.Anchored then
                    t8.value91[p60] = true

                    return true
                end

                t8.value91[p60] = false

                return false
            end
        until v541:find(v545)

        t8.value91[p60] = true

        return true
    end
    local function v272(p61)
        if not p61 or not p61:IsA("BasePart") then
            return
        end

        if t8.value94[p61] then
            return
        end

        if not t8.value88[p61] then
            t8.value88[p61] = p61.Transparency

                SelectionBox.Name = "XRayOutline"
                SelectionBox.Adornee = p61

                SelectionBox.Transparency = 0.7
                SelectionBox.LineThickness = 0.05

            end

        t8.value94[p61] = true
    end

    function t8.value125()
        if not t8.value85 then
            return
        end

        if tick() - t8.value93 < t8.value92 then
            return
        end

        local CFramePosition = t8.value13.CFrame.Position
        local n2 = 50

        for k, _ in pairs(t8.value94) do
            local v553 = k

            if v553 and v553.Parent then
                if n2 < (v553.Position - CFramePosition).Magnitude then
                    v273(v553)
                end
            else
                t8.value94[v553] = nil

                if t8.value88[v553] then
                    t8.value88[v553] = nil
                end
            end
        end

        local vector3 = Vector3.new(n2 * 2, n2 * 2, n2 * 2)
        local region3 = Region3.new(CFramePosition - vector3 / 2, CFramePosition + vector3 / 2)
        local PartsInRegion3 = t8.value5:FindPartsInRegion3(region3, nil, 1e999)

        for _, v in ipairs(PartsInRegion3) do
            if v:IsA("BasePart") then
                local Magnitude = (v.Position - CFramePosition).Magnitude

                if Magnitude < n2 then
                    local raycastResult = t8.value5:Raycast(CFramePosition, (v.Position - CFramePosition).Unit * Magnitude)

                    if raycastResult and v == raycastResult.Instance then
                        v272(v)
                    elseif Magnitude > n2 / 2 and v271(v) then
                        v272(v)
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

        local v680 = p69 or 1

        while v680 > tick() - timestamp do

            if Animate then

                if v683 then
                    v683 = Animate:FindFirstChild("idle")
                end
            end

            if v683 then

            end

            task.wait(0.1)
        end

        return nil
    end

    end

t1.value2.Button(t1.value2, {
	Title = "Play Music",
	Icon = "play",
	Callback = function()
    if t2.value71 then
        t2.value71:Destroy()
    end

    t2.value71 = Instance.new("Sound", workspace)

    if t2.value73 and t2.value74[t2.value73] then
        (function(p75, p76)
            local v702 = "WindUI/Music" .. "/" .. p76

            if not isfolder("WindUI") then
                makefolder("WindUI")
            end

            if not isfolder("WindUI/Music") then
                makefolder("WindUI/Music")
            end

            if not isfile(v702) then
                local v703 = game:HttpGet(p75)

                writefile(v702, v703)
            end

            t2.value71.SoundId = getcustomasset(v702)
            t2.value71.Volume = t2.value72
            t2.value71.Looped = true
            t2.value71:Play()
        end)(t2.value74[t2.value73].Url, t2.value74[t2.value73].FileName)

        return
    end

    if t2.value70 ~= "" then
        t2.value71.SoundId = "rbxassetid://" .. t2.value70
        t2.value71.Volume = t2.value72
        t2.value71.Looped = true
        t2.value71:Play()

        return
    end

    t2.value1:Notify({
			Title = "No Song Selected",
			Desc = "Please select a song from the dropdown.",
			Icon = "alert-circle"
		})
end
})

t1.value2.Toggle(t1.value2, {
	Title = "Rainbow Visualizer",
	Desc = "Show music rhythm bar",
	Callback = function(p79)
    if p79 then
        local ScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui", game.CoreGui)

        ScreenGui.Name = "MusicVisualizer"

        local Frame = Instance.new("Frame", ScreenGui)

        Frame.Name = "BarContainer"
        Frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 300, 0, 40)
        Frame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.9, 0)
        Frame.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1)
        Frame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        Frame.BorderSizePixel = 0

        local t18 = {}

        for i = 1, 50 do
            local Frame3 = Instance.new("Frame", Frame)

            Frame3.Size = UDim2.new(0.02, -1, 0, 10)
            Frame3.Position = UDim2.new((i - 1) / 50, 0, 1, 0)
            Frame3.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1)
            Frame3.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
            Frame3.BorderSizePixel = 0
            table.insert(t18, Frame3)
        end

        task.spawn(function()
            local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

            while true do
                local v705 = ScreenGui

                if v705 then
                    v705 = ScreenGui.Parent
                end

                if not v705 then
                    break
                end

                local value71 = t2.value71

                if value71 then
                    value71 = t2.value71.IsPlaying
                end

                if value71 then
                    value71 = t2.value71.PlaybackLoudness
                end

                local _os = os
                local v708 = value71 or 0
                local v709 = _os.clock() * 0.2

                for i, v in ipairs(t18) do
                    local v712 = math.noise(os.clock() * 2, i * 0.1) + 0.5
                    local v713 = math.max(2, math.clamp(v708 / 300 * v712, 0, 1) * 100)

                    v.Size = UDim2.new(0.02, -1, 0, v713)
                    v.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromHSV((i / 50 + v709) % 1, 0.8, 1)
                end

                RunService.RenderStepped:Wait()
            end
        end)

        return
    end

    local MusicVisualizer = game.CoreGui:FindFirstChild("MusicVisualizer")

    if MusicVisualizer then
        MusicVisualizer:Destroy()
    end
end
})

t1.value2 = task.spawn
t1.value2(function()
    local LocalPlayer15 = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
    local UserIconParent
    local DisplayName
    local UserName
    while not UserIconParent do
        task.wait(0.5)

        local value2 = t2.value2

        if value2 then
            value2 = t2.value2.UIElements

            if value2 then
                value2 = t2.value2.UIElements.Main
            end
        end

        if value2 then
            local UserIcon = t2.value2.UIElements.Main:FindFirstChild("UserIcon", true)

            if UserIcon then
                UserIconParent = UserIcon.Parent

                if UserIconParent then
                    local GetChildren = UserIconParent.GetChildren

                    for _, v in pairs(GetChildren(UserIconParent)) do
                        local v331 = v:IsA("Frame")

                        if v331 then
                            v331 = v.Name ~= "UserIcon"

                            if v331 then
                                v331 = v.Name ~= "Outline"
                            end
                        end

                        if v331 then
                            DisplayName = v:FindFirstChild("DisplayName")
                            UserName = v:FindFirstChild("UserName")

                            if not UserName then
                                local GetChildren2 = v.GetChildren

                                for _, v2 in pairs(GetChildren2(v)) do
                                    local v335 = v2:IsA("TextLabel")

                                    if v335 then
                                        v335 = v2.Name ~= "DisplayName"
                                    end

                                    if v335 then
                                        UserName = v2

                                        break
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    while true do
        local num = tonumber(os.date("%H"))
        local v337 = num < 12 and "Good Morning"

        if not v337 then
            v337 = not (num < 18) and "Good Evening" or "Good Afternoon"
        end

        local v338 = (function(p81)
            local s2 = ""
            local v716 = os.clock() * 0.75

            for i = 1, #p81 do
                s2 ..= "<font color=\"#" .. Color3.fromHSV((i / #p81 + v716) % 1, 1, 1):ToHex() .. "\">" .. string.sub(p81, i, i) .. "</font>"
            end

            return s2
        end)(v337)
        local v339 = os.date("%X")

        if DisplayName then
            DisplayName.Text = v338 .. ", " .. LocalPlayer15.DisplayName
        end

        if UserName then
            UserName.Text = "@" .. LocalPlayer15.Name .. "  |  " .. v339
        end

        task.wait(0.1)
    end
end)
